overlap: Protected-statement counts and synchronization counts are already optimized: coarsest syntactic objective lexicographically minimizes lock statements then protected statements; profiling objective estimates expected block time, contention and acquisition counts.
difference: Our Q counts dynamic foreground completion/validation API invocations, including failed conditional calls, per finite execution. L counts all actual selected protected kernel operations, including cached recomputations. Bounds quantify worst executions under at-most-B own-identity writes and persistent job completion. The exact interface-dependent resource frontier and its causal witnesses differ from static lock placement and statistical expected-time predictions.
claim_impact: Do not claim novel counting/weighting of protection or call operations, novel lock minimization, or measured timing benefit. State joint resource bounds with exact native counters and finite-write assumptions; whole contribution includes normal form and all-budget compilation.
